dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the mid-lateral trunk display a high-contrast transition from a dark exterior to a high-intensity white-gray perimeter ring. The interior centers of these rings exhibit a gradient back toward darker pixel values, forming a target-like geometry with irregular, jagged edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a high spatial density of small, solid high-intensity pixel clusters concentrated along the ventral-lateral margin. These lack internal gradients and appear as clustered points of light pixels against the darker background.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent 'O' rings in the mid-section form a scalene triangle. A distinct linear sequence of smaller high-intensity blobs runs parallel to the ventral curve, forming a chain-like geometric relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: The cranial and facial region displays a unique high-frequency speckle pattern composed of fine, individual high-intensity points that are distinct from the larger macro-annuli topology on the torso.
